title: 12 Best Hot Air Balloon Operators in Bagan, Myanmar
description: Experience the magic of Bagan from above! Discover the top 12 hot-air balloon operators for unforgettable sunrise flights over ancient temples. Find premium experiences, best value, and insider tips.

places.name: Balloons Over Bagan (BOB)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their gourmet champagne breakfast served post-flight at a private landing area is a delightful culmination of the experience.

places.name: Oriental Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy their post-flight sparkling wine toast and light breakfast, often featuring a selection of pastries, fruit, and local delicacies.

places.name: Golden Eagle Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their pre-flight coffee and biscuits keep you warm before the ascent, while a post-flight fruit platter is refreshing.

places.name: STT Ballooning (Shwe Pyi San Travel & Tour)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their post-flight local breakfast spread, featuring traditional Myanmar dishes and fresh fruits, provides a genuine taste of local hospitality.

places.name: Aura Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of juices, water, and light pastries are provided for a refreshing start and end to your journey.

places.name: Sky View Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Expect basic warm beverages and simple snacks before departure, and water bottles upon landing.

places.name: Bagan Thazin Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy some local refreshments and seasonal fruit upon landing, giving you a taste of Myanmar's hospitality.

places.name: Royal Bagan Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their selection of gourmet pastries and premium coffee before the flight, followed by a celebratory toast upon landing, elevates the experience.

places.name: Myanmar Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Simple but satisfying fresh baked goods, tea, and coffee are provided pre-flight, with bottled water available throughout.

places.name: Wonderlust Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order They offer light pre-flight snacks and a celebratory post-flight drink, along with a personalized flight certificate as a souvenir.

places.name: Bagan Star Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a selection of assorted pastries, fresh juice, and local tea during their pre-flight gathering.

places.name: Dream Bagan Ballooning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Basic coffee, water, and light biscuits are typically offered pre-flight, along with a refreshing fruit juice upon landing.
